Recipe:
Pumpkin Pie 2 9-inch Pies From the Kitchen of Bobbi Beagley Jennie's Mom
§ion;
When Jennie and Ransom were first married, they each felt that their mother's pumpkin pie recipe was the best. So, we had a bake-off. In the end, it was decided that Ransom's mom's recipe looked the best, but that Jennie's mom's tasted the best. So, Jennie's mom's is the one we make each year.
Pumpkin1 29-oz. Can Evaporated Milk2 12-fl.Oz. Cans Sugar2 Cups Eggs4 Salt1 teaspoon
Cinnamonground 3 teaspoons
Nutmegground 1 teaspoon
Gingerground 1 teaspoon
Allspiceground 1 teaspoon
Clovesground 1 teaspoon
Preheat oven to 425°.
Mix all ingredients with a beater until smooth.
Pour into pie pans with uncooked pie crust.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
Reduce temperature to 350° and bake for an additional 35 minutes.
You cannot serve pumpkin pie without whipped cream, or vanilla ice cream.
(Or both &smiley;)
